title: Evaluating Cultural Adaptability of a Large Language Model via Simulation of Synthetic Personas

bias_targets.methodology: Simulating human personas from 15 different countries and comparing the LLM's survey responses to persuasive news articles against ground-truth data from human participants, testing whether explicitly stating the country of residence improves alignment.

Prompting the LLM in 12 different languages (including monolingual, native, and randomly shuffled language settings) to evaluate how the language of the prompt affects the model's ability to accurately simulate country-specific human behaviors.
